Plan your visitSunday services

One church. Three Sunday services. A place for you.

We are a worshipping community of many backgrounds and from every part of the city. Whether you join our Traditional, Contemporary or Vernacular service, you will find people glad to see you.

Come as you are. We would love to meet you.

Our vision

The love of God grows us in community, to serve in the world.

Our mission

God calls Bedfordview Methodist Church to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ for healing and transformation.

A story of more than a century

From a Sunday School in borrowed rooms to the sanctuary we worship in today, our congregation has grown with Bedfordview.

  • 1920sMethodist work begins as a Sunday School and occasional preaching place. The congregation meets in private homes, the old Village Hall, the old Bedfordview Primary School (now the Police station) and the Town Hall, diagonally across the road from today’s site.
  • 1965On 23 April, a church opens on the corner of van Buuren Road and De Wet Street. It later becomes our main hall.
  • 1982The present sanctuary is built and inaugurated.
  • 2018A substantial renovation expands our space and modernises the interior and exterior. In October, we celebrate our 95th anniversary.

Sunday worship that mirrors our diversity

Each service has its own character. Choose the one that feels like home.

  • 08H30

    Traditional Service

    A Sunday morning service in our traditional form of worship.

  • 10H00

    Contemporary Service

    Worship in a contemporary style for the whole congregation.

  • 11H00

    Vernacular Service

    A service in the vernacular, celebrating the language and culture of our community.

  • 18H00

    Fellowship Group

    An evening gathering. A minister joins us once a month for Holy Communion.
